# ExifReader

`exif-reader-4.46.0.js` is the unmodified browser bundle from the
`exifreader@4.46.0` npm package, with its original `exif-reader.js.map` source map.
It is distributed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0; see `ExifReader-LICENSE`.

Upstream source for this version:
https://github.com/mattiasw/ExifReader/tree/v4.46.0

To update, download a specific release with `npm pack exifreader@VERSION
--ignore-scripts`, then copy `package/dist/exif-reader.js`,
`package/dist/exif-reader.js.map`, and `package/LICENSE`
from the archive. Update the versioned filename and gallery template's
`data-exif-reader-src` URL,
and rerun the EXIF and viewer checks. No npm install is needed to build the site.
